Image to Video Generator Free v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly animate still images into engaging videos, free of charge.
- Simple workflow: upload photos, describe motion or style, and receive a dynamic video.
- Supports animated effects (zoom, pan, crossfade, floating, etc.) and slideshows.
- Handles video rendering in the cloud with no local processing or technical setup.
- Works for social media, business, education, and creative projects — no editing skills required.
